extracted.name: Caramel frappé
extracted.description: Cool down and get your caffeine fix with a homemade frappé using espresso and caramel sauce. Top with whipped cream for an indulgent touch
ingredient_lines: 75g caramel sauce plus extra to serve
instruction_lines: Tip all the ingredients except the whipped cream into a high-powered blender and blitz until smooth. Pour into a glass and top with whipped cream and a drizzle of caramel sauce, if you like.
